title: THE LONG WAY BACK · I · The magic shop
venue: the sabbatical · never posted · found in Box 9
logline: Stop one: a shop in Florence that sells kites and, in the back, tricks — a table with a cup and a ball and a coin and a wand, nobody at it. The card in the drawer that night: a man at that table with the tools laid out, one hand up, one down. The traveler buys a kite.
